Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Deploy GitHub Pages

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'gh-pages/**'
      - 'analysis/model/src/main/kotlin/de/maibornwolff/codecharta/model/Project.kt'
      # Changes to the deploy step itself must republish, otherwise a fixed workflow
      # only takes effect on the next unrelated docs change.
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-github-pages.yml'
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Build & Deploy Docs (Astro) to GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: gh-pages

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Setup Java for example validation
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5.2.0
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 25

      - name: Validate documentation example
        working-directory: analysis
        run: ./gradlew :ccsh:run --args="check ../../gh-pages/src/assets/examples/minimal.cc.json"

      - name: Build site
        run: npm run build

      # Publishes the built static site (gh-pages/dist) to the gh-pages branch.
      # The Web Studio app (visualization/app/), the archived visualization coverage report
      # (visualization/coverage/, linked from the README) and staging (stg/) live on the same
      # branch but are not built here, so they are preserved via clean-exclude.
      # dist/ already contains CNAME and .nojekyll (from public/), the latter stops
      # GitHub Pages from running Jekyll over the _astro/ asset directory.
      # The clean-exclude patterns must be anchored with a leading slash and name the folder
      # exactly: they are passed to rsync, which matches an unanchored pattern against the
      # end of every path, so `visualization/**` also excluded docs/visualization/** and the
      # site's own /visualization redirect from the upload.
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4.8.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
          branch: gh-pages
          folder: gh-pages/dist
          clean-exclude: |
            /stg
            /visualization/app
            /visualization/coverage

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
